2607.17535.title: Salience Induction against Multi-Hop RAG Agents: Threat and Defense
2607.17535.paper_summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly retrieve external evidence and orchestrate tools for knowledge-intensive applications. In Multi-Hop question answering, agents chain facts across documents. Existing defenses focus on content poisoning, which injects false facts, and prompt injection, which embeds directives. We identify a third attack surface: the salience channel, through which fact position, emphasis, framing, and semantic proximity can redirect reasoning even when all retrieved claims are true and no instructions are present. We formalize Salience Induction as truth-preserving edits that redirect Multi-Hop attribute binding while leaving the retrieval trace semantically intact. We define six Salience-Editing operator classes and build an iterative proposer-verifier pipeline under factual and stealth constraints. We also introduce SalientWiki-MH, a decoy-annotated Multi-Hop benchmark. Evaluations across five frontier model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Qwen) and three agent architectures (ReAct, Reflexion, and tool-calling) show broad generalization. Under a 30% edit budget, Salience Induction achieves an 83.3% attack success rate; the strongest evaluated baseline defense leaves 75.7% post-defense ASR. Untargeted rewriting further reduces attacks only by degrading neutral task success. Our lightweight input-side defense, Salience Normalization, reduces attack success to 15.3% under standard attacks and 23.6% under an adaptive attack. These results show that truthfulness and instruction filtering alone are insufficient: robust agentic RAG also requires defenses against salience-relevance decoupling.
2607.17535.paper_summary_zh: 代理檢索增強生成（RAG）系統越來越多地檢索外部證據並協調工具以應對知識密集型應用。<lb/>在多跳問答中，代理在文檔之間鏈接事實。<lb/>現有的防禦措施集中於內容中毒，這會注入虛假事實，以及提示注入，這會嵌入指令。<lb/>我們識別出第三種攻擊面：顯著性通道，通過該通道，事實的位置、強調、框架和語義接近性可以重新引導推理，即使所有檢索的主張都是真實的且沒有指令存在。<lb/>我們將顯著性引導形式化為保持真實性的編輯，這些編輯重新引導多跳屬性綁定，同時保持檢索痕跡在語義上不變。<lb/>我們定義了六種顯著性編輯操作類別，並在事實和隱蔽約束下建立了一個迭代的提議者-驗證者管道。<lb/>我們還引入了SalientWiki-MH，一個帶有誘餌標註的多跳基準。<lb/>在五個前沿模型系列（GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek 和 Qwen）和三種代理架構（ReAct、Reflexion 和工具調用）上的評估顯示出廣泛的泛化能力。<lb/>在30%的編輯預算下，顯著性引導達到了83.3%的攻擊成功率；最強的評估基線防禦留下了75.7%的防禦後ASR。<lb/>無目標重寫進一步減少攻擊，僅通過降低中立任務的成功率。<lb/>我們的輕量級輸入側防禦，顯著性正規化，在標準攻擊下將攻擊成功率降低到15.3%，在自適應攻擊下降低到23.6%。<lb/>這些結果表明，僅僅依賴真實性和指令過濾是不夠的：強健的代理RAG還需要針對顯著性-相關性解耦的防禦。
